_comment: Documents in src/packs that deliberately differ from what the SRD import produces, keyed by slug. src/packs is the source of truth, so the correction itself is in the pack document; this is the record of which ones were changed and why, which is what lets a check tell a decision from a regression. Written by scripts/capture_edits.py when an edit is captured out of Foundry.

spear.why: weapons.html: 'This primitive device is a reach weapon. A character can strike opponents 10 feet away with it, but can't use it against an adjacent foe.' The melee table has no reach column.

chain.why: weapons.html: 'If a character uses the chain as a reach weapon, he or she can strike opponents up to 10 feet away. In addition, unlike other weapons with reach, the character can use it against an adjacent foe.'

ruger-service-six-38s-revolver.why: The SRD abbreviates .38 special as '.38S' in this weapon's name, so it does not match the ammunition entry.

sawed-off-shotgun-12-ga-shotgun.why: Abbreviated '12-ga' in the name; the ammunition entry is '12-gauge buckshot'.

benelli-121-m1-12-gague-shotgun.why: The SRD misspells gauge as 'gague' in this weapon's name.

crossbow-simple.why: Fires crossbow bolts, which the ammunition table lists but the weapon's name does not.

m79-grenade-launcher.why: Fires 40mm grenades, which are weapons in their own right rather than an ammunition entry. Left blank so reloading does not consume anything.

m2hb-heavy-machine-gun.why: The SRD names no ammunition type for it. Left blank so reloading does not consume anything.

m-60-medium-machine-gun.why: The SRD names no ammunition type for it.

m72a3-law-rocket-launcher.why: Single-use launcher; the SRD names no separate ammunition.

taser-simple.why: Fires darts, which the ammunition table does not list.

pepper-spray-simple.why: A canister rather than a magazine; no ammunition entry exists.

flamethrower-no-feat-needed.why: Fuel rather than rounds; the SRD names no ammunition entry.

sap.why: weapons.html: 'This weapon, essentially a smaller version of a club, deals nonlethal damage instead of lethal damage.' The melee table has no nonlethal column.

acid-mild.why: The SRD's row for this splash weapon does not line up with its own header: the critical and damage type columns hold '1' and '20', putting a number where the damage type belongs. Corrected from the row's own remaining cells.

molotov-cocktail.why: Same malformed row shape as Acid, mild - '20' lands in the damage type column.
